title: Clearer downloads, round controls and more Shaiya knowledge
changes: Changed the Support and download queue close controls to compact circular buttons with centered icons and keyboard focus support.

Expanded Information from 41 to 50 articles and from 33 to 39 sources. Added the official Fawkes overview, historical race/class relationships and party roles, archive tool capabilities, and the context needed to read legacy RaGEZONE setup guides.

Added the shStudio author's 0.9.0.6 monster-data saving fix with a maintainer-confirmed label and version limits. Added separate FixRange editing guidance; unresolved issues are not presented as fixed.

Replaced SSMS 22 with the owner-requested Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio 19.3 standalone installer. Verified the full download size, SHA-256 and embedded product version; SQL Server 2019 Express remains a separate unchanged download.
Added optional file descriptions to explain installer purpose before download. Previous SSMS metadata is archived outside the active catalog.

Updated the Turkish support setup guide with Patreon Shop one-time purchases, clearly separated from recurring membership and direct donations. Support remains inactive until a real public page is configured.

title: A growing library and everyday developer tools
changes: Expanded Information from 19 to 41 articles across seven categories, with 33 named sources. Added class and faction concepts, database files, transactions, permissions, restore checks, configuration routing, map editing, encoding, file hashes and change review.

Added five resolution articles: three maintainer-confirmed Parsec fixes (versions 1.1.0, 1.1.1 and 1.2.0) and Microsoft-documented SQL 18456/4064 diagnostic routes. Resolution labels distinguish published evidence from local reproduction; no universal episode compatibility is claimed.

Files now supports a persistent sequential download queue. Add more files while a transfer runs; inspect, reorder or remove waiting items in a dedicated queue window. Pause stops the queue; an error preserves the current partial file and waiting work for an explicit retry.

Queue state survives application restarts and preserves existing single-download resume data. Downloads do not start automatically when reopening the application. Finished files expose Open folder; program files are never executed by the downloader.

Added Tools, a local program launcher with executable selection, friendly names, saved shortcuts, launch, relocation and shortcut-only removal. Missing executables are identified. Programs launch only on an explicit click.

Added a dark-and-gold Support the project button and window. The external payment link is remotely configurable; it remains disabled until the owner supplies a real support page. Added a Turkish Patreon setup and payout guide.

Extended automated checks for queue ordering, duplicate destinations, interruptions, promotion recovery, launcher persistence, support URLs and solution labels; added Windows UI scenarios for the queue, tools and support windows.

title: A source-backed knowledge library
changes: Information now opens a live knowledge library with seven categories: Shaiya, Server Side, SQL & Database, Client Side, Editing Tools, Development Tools and Troubleshooting.
Added 19 introductory articles with named sources, review dates, scope notes and clear distinctions between documented information, inspected packages and recommended workflows.

Category cards open a separate dark-and-gold reader with a topic menu, category selection, article search, source links and readable code examples. Close the reader or press Esc to return to your workspace.
Knowledge content loads from GitHub and can be expanded without a new app release. Validated saved content remains available offline; invalid updates do not replace the last good copy.

EP6.4 service/configuration articles are based on static package inspection. Original-game technology and unverified historical dates are not asserted as facts. No server, SQL query or example command is executed by the reader.
Added schema/search/cache tests and Windows reader checks covering category navigation, empty search results, source visibility and returning to the main window.

title: Refreshed tools & cleaner window controls
changes: Fixed title-bar and About buttons keeping a highlight after minimize/restore or closing About. Keyboard navigation still has a dedicated focus outline.
Moved all five EP5.4 references out of the active library into content/disabled/ep5.4-references.json, ready to restore later.
Replaced generic SSMS entries with SQL Server 2019 Express (64-bit) and SSMS 22, which supports SQL Server 2019.
Updated developer tools to Visual Studio Community 2026 Stable, XAMPP 8.5.12 (64-bit), and Visual Studio Code 1.146.0 (64-bit), using verified official download sources.
Archived the old VS Code 32-bit entry because the current version no longer supports 32-bit Windows. Previous tool records remain available in content/disabled/superseded-tools-2026-11-12.json.
The active catalog now contains 133 entries. New download links passed executable-signature and HTTP range checks; installers were not run.

title: The purpose behind the workspace
changes: Added a gold information icon beside the title-bar window controls.
A dedicated About window introduces the project's purpose, current features and future direction in clear English, written from the perspective of its solo developer.
Future guides, a growing resource library, server management and theme preferences are clearly labeled as plans rather than available features.
The About window matches the dark-and-gold theme, scales to fit smaller screens, and closes with Esc, the close icon or Back to workspace. Your current workspace stays in place.

title: Faster closing & the first resource library
changes: Idle windows close directly without re-entering the Closing event.
Active downloads finish cancellation after the window is hidden, preserving resume data.
Online content requests are cancelled on exit; transfer I/O stays off the UI thread.

Files remain hosted at OpenShaiya, including the downloads larger than 2 GB. Refresh Files and Version Notes to see the expanded catalog and this history.

Refresh controls and a validated offline cache for both content sources.
